title: Samsung Galaxy S25 256GB (Navy)
description:
Introducing the new Galaxy S25, the epic next wave of smartphone technology.

Tackle your day with ease with the help of even smarter Galaxy AI1. Ask your device to do a few things at once, the same way you would naturally ask a person. Start your day with a rundown of all the information you need to know with Now Brief.

Shoot and share your best memories with a powerful 50MP camera, powered by an advanced AI engine, with upgraded Nightography and Portrait Modes2, for stunningly clear and natural images, day and night.
 
Show your style with a range of stylish colours in a sleek and durable curved edge design.

Enjoy some added peace of mind knowing you have the freedom to customise your own security settings and your on-device personalised AI data can’t be accessed by other apps with Knox Vault encryption.

Experience gaming and entertainment like never before with the latest chipset for faster speeds and extra power efficiency2, and a self-optimising, long lasting battery to power you through your day.
 
A bright, more vibrant, and lifelike display will captivate you when you’re gaming, or even just scrolling.

Key Features

Make your everyday simple, with Galaxy AI1
Enjoy getting more things done, the simpler way with Galaxy AI1 on the Galaxy S25. Find a great pet-friendly restaurant nearby and message your friend to arrange a meeting time in a single step. Just ask in the natural way you would ask a person and it will process your request, performing complex tasks across multiple apps. Be ready for the day ahead from the moment you wake up, with Now Brief. Delivering your personalised insights, from weather, new, health stats, to calendar reminders and more. It’s your ultimate personal assistant.

Epic portraits and night videos5
Take your best shots yet, day or night, on the Galaxy S25. Featuring an added range of up to 5x digital zoom in Portrait Mode and epic 50MP lens, the upgraded Nightography mode features 2-steps of noise reduction so you can shoot photos and video as clear as day, even when the sun goes down. Plus, the Galaxy S25 is now powered by an object-aware advanced AI engine1, reducing light distortion to show your skin’s best natural glow.

Your personal AI on-device data safeguarded with encryption
Stay in control of your privacy on the Galaxy S25. You have the freedom of personalising your security settings and opting in-or-out of Galaxy AI features1, for some added peace of mind. Knox Vault encryption ensures Galaxy AI on-device personalised data is secure and protected, so no other apps can access it.

Sleek design with new epic colours
Step up your style with the simply striking design of the Galaxy S25. Robustly designed, it features an IP684 rating for water and dust resistance and strong Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 23. Streamlined with classic curved edges for your comfort, it comes in a range of stylish new colours, made for epic self-expression.

Powered by the latest processor coupled with an epic 4000mAh battery
Enjoy performance that powers good times. The Galaxy S25 features an enhanced2 built-in vapour chamber and the latest chipset, customised for Galaxy. It gives you faster speeds and extra power efficiency2 for seamless gaming and epic entertainment on-the-go, all powered by a self-optimising and long lasting battery that you can rely on.

Samsung's best display now powered by AI
Gaming never looked so good on the Galaxy S25. Immerse yourself in other worlds with a Dynamic AMOLED 2X display and AI-powered scaler1, giving you better image quality and advanced ray tracing for unbelievable graphic detail.
